index.title: Messages
index.emptyBody: Start one with a friend. Messages you send and get show up here.
index.pickBody: Your chats with friends and groups show up here.

push.title: Get notified when friends write
push.body: Turn on notifications on this device for direct and group messages.
push.installTitle: Add Manteion to your Home Screen
push.installBody: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work once Manteion is on your Home Screen. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Manteion in this browser’s settings.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.failed: Couldn’t turn on notifications. Try again.

show.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
show.confirmDelete: It is removed for everyone in the conversation.
show.muteHint: No pushes for this chat, and it isn’t counted on the badge.
show.confirmLeave: You stop getting its messages. Someone in it can add you again.
show.sendFailed: Your message wasn’t sent. Check your connection and try again.

create.title: New message
create.groupNameHint: Only used when you pick more than one person.
create.noFriends: You can message your friends. Find people on the Contacts page first.
